wholePhysicalScope: Current named OpenStreetMap outline, two exact cleared Qualla exterior photographs, National Historic Landmark architectural description and the original elevation field.
lodDetails: Four levels preserve the square bell tower, Gothic lancets and the red gabled nave.
limitations: The tower elevation is scaled from photographs against the mapped church and documented lancet height. The proportions of some tracery, the back and the small roof projections are estimated. Interior and churchyard objects are outside the scope of this model.
